components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Paper fill on the dark console.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #e7e1d4; color: #1c1914; border: 1px solid #e7e1d4; border-radius: 0; padding: 6px 10px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #f3eee4; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e0c14a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Alert Button
components.description: Stop control. Red is reserved for this.
components.css: .ds-btn-alert { background: #d24a3d; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #d24a3d; border-radius: 0; padding: 6px 10px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-btn-alert:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e0c14a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Console Button
components.description: Secondary chrome on the console field.
components.css: .ds-btn-console { background: #1a1d26; color: #ece8df; border: 1px solid #3a3f4c; border-radius: 0; padding: 6px 10px; } .ds-btn-console:hover { background: #242833; } .ds-btn-console:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e0c14a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Paper Strip
components.description: Flight-progress strip: square tab, callsign, state, actions.
components.css: .ds-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 14px minmax(0,1fr) auto auto; gap: 8px; align-items: center; background: #e7e1d4; color: #1c1914; border: 1px solid #b7ae9c; border-radius: 0; padding: 8px 10px; } .ds-tab { width: 10px; height: 10px; background: #3d8f5a; } .ds-strip-body b { display: block; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 13px; } .ds-strip-body small { color: #5e574c; font-size: 11px; } .ds-strip-meta { font-size: 11px; color: #5e574c; } .ds-strip-start { background: #1c1914; color: #e7e1d4; border: 1px solid #1c1914; border-radius: 0; padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 11px; }

components.name: Console Field
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; color: #1c1914; font-size: 14px; } .ds-field input { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #b7ae9c; color: #1c1914; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 0; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e0c14a; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Agent Bus is a local operator instrument, not an admin SaaS shell. The operator watches independent agents the way a controller watches flights: paper strips on a dark console, live figures in cyan, yellow only for wayfinding, red only to stop.

The dashboard is one surface: a yellow-ruled sector header, a display-size mission, two strip bays, and a phosphor live log. Providers live in a header popover. Projects and runs are header selects. State is a square tab on the strip, never a tinted card or a colored side stripe.
keyCharacteristics: Dark console field with cream paper strips
Cyan for live numbers and log time; yellow for labels; red reserved for stop
Square corners, 1px rules, no glass and no gradient type
Callsigns and log in mono; UI chrome in the system sans
Topology is sector / mission / bay / console, never nav + metric cards + identical agent cards

rules.name: The Color-as-State Rule
rules.body: Color marks status or a stop, not decoration. If a region is not live, not a label, and not an alert, it stays console or paper.

rules.name: The Reserved-Red Rule
rules.body: Red is stop and failure only. Do not use it for links, badges, or emphasis.

rules.name: The Callsign Rule
rules.body: Agent and task titles on paper use mono. Prose on paper uses the UI sans.

dos: Do put work on paper strips and keep the field dark.
Do keep providers in the header popover, not a left rail.
Do use a square tab for state.
Do reserve red for stop and failure.
donts: Don't rebuild the three-column admin shell (nav + metric cards + identical agent cards).
Don't use a colored border-left as status.
Don't load webfonts; CSP is font-src 'self'.
Don't use Inter, gradient text, glass, or emoji as icons.
